question: What practice should be maintained continually in connection with the yoginī assembly?
premises: The practice should be done always at the proper time.
It is connected with the yoginī assembly.
inference: One should always partake of that in the context of the yoginī assembly.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat is supplied by the preceding verses.
plain_english: One should always partake of that at the proper time, when there is an assembly of yoginīs.
